Generic – Option Clause The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration by up to 25 % at the time of award of the contract, subject to the applicable GeM terms and conditions. After issuance of the contract, the contract quantity or duration may be increased by up to 25%, wherever permissible under the applicable GeM provisions. The successful bidder/service provider shall be bound to accept such variations in accordance with the ter ms and conditions of the contract. 2. Generic – Excess Settlement Clause Where the Excess Settlement facility is enabled and permissible under the applicable GeM provisions, the Service Provider may claim additional charges up to the prescribed percentage of the item-level contract v alue, including applicable add-ons. The Service Provider shall declare the applicability of such additional charges at the time of invoice genera tion and upload the requisite supporting documents substantiating the claim. The total invoice amount, including additional charges, shall not exceed the permissible excess settlement limit specified in the contract and shall remain subject to verification and approval by the competent autho rity. 3. Generic – Financial Standing of the Bidder The bidder shall not be under liquidation, court receivership, bankruptcy, insolvency or any similar procee dings at the time of submission of the bid. The bidder shall upload a duly signed undertaking/declaration confirming compliance with the above requi rement along with the bid documents. 4. Generic – Assignment and Subcontracting 4.1 Assignment of Contract The successful bidder/service provider shall not assign or transfer the contract, either wholly or partly, to a ny other person, firm or entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the Buyer. 4.2 Subcontracting

The successful bidder/service provider shall not subcontract the services covered under the contract, eithe r wholly or partly, to any third party without obtaining the prior written consent of the Buyer. 4.3 Responsibility and Liability Notwithstanding any consent granted by the Buyer for assignment or subcontracting, the successful bidder /service provider shall remain jointly and severally liable with the assignee or subcontractor, as applicable, for the due and satisfactory performance of the contract and fulfillment of all contractual obligations. 5. Service and Support – Availability of Office of Service Provider The bidder/service provider shall have an operational office located within the State of Assam, being the St ate of the Consignee/Buyer, for effective coordination, communication and timely delivery of the required Tax Consultancy Services. Documentary evidence establishing the existence and location of such office shall be uploaded along with the bid. 6. Certificates and Mandatory Documents The bidder shall upload all certificates, declarations, undertakings and other supporting documents prescri bed in the Bid Document, Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) and any corrigendum issued in connectio n with the tender. Failure to submit any mandatory certificate or document, as required under the applicable bid conditions, s hall render the bid liable to rejection, subject to the applicable GeM provisions. .
